requirement: Publication claims identify actual vs synthetic evidence
Energized operation requires written/recorded facility approval and induction
Appropriate isolated current-limited supply, protection and thermal stop rules are verified
DUT operating point is within manufacturer SOA, dissipation and temperature constraints
Every primary measurement channel has stated range, reference evidence and suitability
Uncertainty covers measured V,I, temperature, timing and fixture variation
Confirmatory holdouts are at configuration/remount level and sealed before assessment
Sample size and stopping are justified from pilot precision and physical constraints
Experimental raw files are immutable, timestamped, hashed and quality-flagged
Physics and numerical checks pass and are maintained in CI
Claims about internal junction temperature require qualified evidence or explicit model label
Prior-art comparison identifies novelty limitations before manuscript claims
Clean checkout regenerates key report outputs from released datasets
Public release and facility photo/data rights recorded
Deviations/aborted runs preserved and exclusion rules predeclared
No claims of formal KTH sponsorship, accredited lab, or qualified JEDEC tests without evidence
Mechanical mount/interfaces uniquely identifiable and reassembly documented
Manuscript conclusions separate verification, validation, uncertainty and model limits
Every scope/method change is controlled and logged
Portfolio identifies researcher contributions with direct evidence links
